title: Assisted Living Returned-Payment Charge Amount
content:
Under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, the returned-payment charge is the returned payment fee of the resident account terms, rounded once to the cent half up at the end.

| Item (hypothetical returned check) | Figure |
|---|---|
| Returned payment fee of the resident account terms | 40.00 |
| Returned-payment charge, rounded once to the cent | 40.00 |

The charge is a fee for the return itself; the amount of the payment that was returned is reinstated on the account separately, by the entry that reinstated the payment.
